answer: Sponsors lock 100 saffron coins for each newcomer they vouch, burning if the newcomer is exposed as fake within a month. An attacker running 1000 fake identities pays linearly, burning 100,000 saffron coins if even one identity is exposed. Inlet periods limit new sponsors, preventing rapid influxes of fake identities, ensuring the bond's effectiveness. Mesa phases adjust the bond requirements, scaling up the cost as needed.
